question: What is the value of the following expression? \[100(100-3)-(100 \cdot 100-3)\]
solution:
Evaluate each parenthesized expression before taking the final difference. The first term is \(100(100-3)=100\cdot97=9700\), and the second parenthesis is \(100\cdot100-3=10000-3=9997\). Thus
\[
100(100-3)-(100\cdot100-3)
=9700-9997=\boxed{-297},
\]
which is choice \(\text{C}\).
